purpose: Services relationship: operative commitments below follow your notes. The parties are starting and running a mobile coffee cart together. party_a funded the trailer and machines, and those items stay party_a’s personal property unless the parties sign a written transfer. party_b will handle the daily operations of the cart. The business ownership split is 60/40. Any future cash put into the venture is treated as a loan first unless the parties later agree in writing to convert it into ownership. Spending above $500 requires approval from both parties before the expense is made. If either party wants to exit or transfer their interest, the other party gets the first right to buy at fair market value, with value determined using the trailing 6 months earnings or an independent appraisal. The parties want a clear dispute path that starts with mediation and, if needed, moves to binding arbitration. Monthly payouts are made after expenses and after keeping a 10% reserve.
